artifacts.summary: 8-phase, ~10h plan covering Piece 1 (heartbeat silence diagnosed in writing as a design gap, then closed core-side via a shared heartbeat library pulsed at dispatch boundaries plus an advisory adoption lint), Piece 2 (additive held-live third lock state in cmd_check at exit code 1, and a session_liveness() consult in cmd_acquire's cross-task overlap pass), Piece 3 (derive_union_file_scope shared by session-register and session-heartbeat), and both absorbed defects (earlier batch_session_id mint threading --session-id into the pre-dispatch review; corrected MAX_TASKS message at both sites).

user_decision.question: Piece 1's functional gap is closed core-side by a dispatch-boundary heartbeat, but 13 of the 14 phase-heading-owning implementation agents still never invoke update-phase-status.sh; those 13 files live in 12 other extensions, outside this task's declared file_scope. How should the per-agent migration be handled?
options: Keep this task core-only; land the dispatch-boundary pulse plus an advisory lint recording the 13, and create a separate follow-up task for the per-extension migration
Widen this task's file_scope now to include the 13 cross-extension agent files and migrate them in this task
Keep this task core-only and leave the 13 permanently on the advisory lint with no follow-up migration
user_decision.recommended: Keep this task core-only; land the dispatch-boundary pulse plus an advisory lint recording the 13, and create a separate follow-up task for the per-extension migration

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new output state to a shell CLI whose consumers gate on EXIT CODES with a catch-all branch, prefer a new output-line PREFIX carrying an EXISTING exit code over a new exit code. Concretely in task-lock.sh: `check`'s three consumers (reconcile-task-status.sh's demote gate, orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh's Gate #6, orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's lock probe) all switch on 0/1/2 plus a catch-all; a new code 4 would make unwind hard-error and cycle-plan proceed optimistically over a live lock, whereas reusing code 1 (held-fresh's 'a live session may be working') routes the new held-live state to exactly the right behavior at all three sites with zero consumer edits. Also pick a prefix that is a substring of neither existing prefix (held-live, not held-stale-pid-alive) so a future substring consumer cannot mis-match.
